description: Configure a module. For email: just provide email_address + email_password — settings are auto-detected for 30K+ providers. For advanced/OAuth: use email_provider + manual fields. Supported modules: email, calendar, messaging, search.

calendar_caldav_password.description: CalDAV password (or app-specific password for iCloud/Fastmail)

calendar_caldav_url.description: CalDAV server URL (e.g. https://caldav.icloud.com, https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav, https://dav.mailbox.org)

calendar_default_calendar_id.description: Default calendar ID. For Google: "primary". For CalDAV: the calendar URL from calendar_list_calendars.

calendar_oauth_access_token.description: Google OAuth2 access token (for Google provider)

calendar_oauth_client_id.description: Google OAuth2 client ID (for Google provider)

calendar_oauth_client_secret.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (for Google provider)

calendar_oauth_refresh_token.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token (for Google provider)

calendar_provider.description: Calendar provider: "google" (default) or "caldav" (iCloud, Nextcloud, mailbox.org, Posteo, Radicale, any CalDAV server)

email_address.description: Email address (e.g. info@meinefirma.de). Auto-detects IMAP/SMTP settings for 30K+ providers. Just provide this + email_password for quick setup.

email_password.description: Email password or app password. Used with auto-detected IMAP/SMTP settings.

email_provider.description: Email provider. Not needed if email_address is provided (auto-detected). Use for OAuth flows (gmail/outlook).

image_flux_api_key.description: fal.ai API key for Flux Pro (best for photorealistic). ~$0.04/image.

image_gemini_api_key.description: Google AI API key for Gemini / Imagen 3 (versatile fallback). ~$0.04-0.30/image.

image_openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key for DALL-E 3 image generation (best for text/logos). ~$0.04-0.12/image.

search_brave_api_key.description: Brave Search API key (2000 queries/month free)

search_exa_api_key.description: Exa API key — enables search_semantic + search_code_context (see exa.ai pricing)

search_tavily_api_key.description: Tavily API key — enables search_research (1000 free credits/month, advanced=2 credits/query)

name: suite_setup
